title: Charles Burney and the 'ivory tower' of Urartian history

tellings.quote: region there was a man named Charles Bernie who was like the you could call him the grandfather of your Artin history

plain: A scholar named Charles Burney, whom a researcher named Matt LaCroix calls "the grandfather of Urartian history," shaped how academics understand Urartu, an ancient kingdom around Lake Van in what is now Turkey. LaCroix brings him up on Michels' show without naming a source, as the figure behind an established, ivory-tower view of the region's past that LaCroix wants to question.
